fields.title: Core-law instability is reproduced; the reported 7–11kPa range is not the new pair of paths
fields.evidence: An independent acoustic-tensor calculation gives pure-simple-shear loss of ellipticity at 0.087740979 MPa (W) and 0.087868882 MPa (L) with E_in=0.01MPa. Interpolating the owner's new R10 paths at 0.088MPa gives 10.126661 and 16.750523kPa for 16.057/9.318mm dimples, not a 7–11kPa pair. The pure-shear threshold is not a full-state stability calculation.
fields.proposed_fix: Correct the carried range and preserve the constitutive limitation. Replace the unsourced in-plane law or model cells; do not interpret coarse elastic maxima as physical capacities.

claim: Core-law instability is reproduced; the reported 7–11kPa range is not the new pair of paths
numerical_scope: Source NFI carried without a new independent check
qualification: 047's regularizing in-plane core moduli remain unsourced, and its face-compression screen uses a tensile proxy. The 1.209–1.227 mm tolerance at SF1 is model-only. The 056 target, 6.03 MPa, is simulated rather than a physical collapse measurement; 6.159 MPa agreement supplies no P2 gamma. [047 disposition](unpublished-local-ref:7472c3f9ee41a250), [056 disposition](unpublished-local-ref:a6b49a9c06df2016).
